create_ProgressBar: create a ProgressBar instance to display task completion progress with ETA in the terminal
run_track_progress: run track_progress to apply a function to each task in a list with a progress bar
run_track_parallel_progress: run track_parallel_progress to apply a function across multiple processes with a progress bar
run_track_iter_progress: run track_iter_progress to iterate over tasks with a progress bar yielding each item
run_init_pool: run init_pool to create a multiprocessing Pool with an optional initializer function and args
